project.name: InterSubMod exact-PS x HP regional mutation-state candidate-tree reconstruction
project.primary_goal: Reconstruct auditable local read-compatible minimum mutation-state candidate trees and report identifiability without overstating cellular lineage.

scope.technical_pair_note: HCC1395 and HCC1395_DORADO are one biological cell line measured with different technical pipelines.

model_contract.parent_mapping: one selected Hamming-1 predecessor per non-root selected vertex
model_contract.read_af_method: family-specific supported-pattern ALT/(REF+ALT), X excluded from each site denominator

known_limitations: 10,717 mutation-bearing units are explicit resource abstains and are non-randomly concentrated at larger active k.
Current read-AF uses final-sample molecule prevalence and has no clone-size sampling or overdispersion model.
Allele-specific CNV, copy-neutral LOH, subclonal CNA, mutation multiplicity, purity and copy loss are not integrated.
Arithmetic unique AF winners have no bootstrap or posterior stability gate.
The current output field input_vaf_eligible is false while internal supported-pattern read-AF ranking is still performed; the semantics must be split before release.
The primary mutation model allows recurrence across branches and is not a strict perfect phylogeny solver.
The frozen AF layer excludes 45 all-recurrence minimum families because the ancestry-monotonic AF interpretation assumes recurrence-free acquisition; structure remains available.
Future mixed recurrence-compatible and recurrence-incompatible minimum families need an explicit compatible-subset or whole-unit-abstain policy.
Local PS x HP blocks cannot be stitched into a whole-sample cellular phylogeny without bridging evidence and a union re-solve.
Methylation is association-only and cannot select an edge or establish a clone.
The thesis draft predates the 2026-07-24 and 2026-07-27 results.
The InterSubMod and LongLineage working trees are dirty; current mtimes and Git HEAD alone are not release authority.
